title: I’m experimenting with a webtoon-style approach to game storytelling
author: acXes
selftext:
I’m experimenting with a webtoon-style approach to game storytelling

I’ve been working on a game concept for a while, and I recently built a small prototype to test one part of it: storytelling.

Instead of traditional game cutscenes, I’m experimenting with a webtoon/comic-panel format where the player progresses through the story panel by panel.

The artwork is currently being generated with Google Flow, and I’m exploring how far I can take this approach while still making it feel like a game rather than just an interactive comic.

This is not a finished game — it’s an early storytelling prototype.



Demo: [https://acxes.netlify.app/](https://acxes.netlify.app/)

Tell me if any other tool I am use.



AI disclosure:

The comic artwork/images in this prototype were generated using Google Flow. AI was used to generate and iterate on the visual artwork used in the storytelling panels. The game concept, story direction, scene structure, panel sequencing, interactive experience, and overall creative direction are my own.
